    What was the most controversial best actor win?
    Marlon Brando's rejection (1973)

    When Marlon Brando won best actor for The Godfather, he decided not to show up. Instead, he sent Sacheen Littlefeather, an actress and activist, to turn down the award on his behalf. She was supposed to read a 15-page speech, but was unable to do so because of time constraints.    3 days ago

    What's in an $178000 Oscars gift bag?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    A $178,000 Oscars gift bag (the 2024 "Everyone Wins" bag) is packed with luxury experiences, wellness treatments, high-end beauty products, and unique gadgets, including trips to Switzerland/St. Barts, home renovations, designer skincare (Miage), Potenza microneedling, Thor wine fridge, Antigua Cruz Tequila, Helight sleep therapy, and custom 3D selfies, provided by Distinctive Assets, not the Academy itself, for top nominees.
     
    Travel & Experiences
    • Luxury Stays: Three-night stays in Zermatt, Switzerland, and a St. Barts villa. 
    • Wellness Retreats: A seven-day holistic retreat in Southern California or a wellness experience in Sri Lanka (Santani). 
    • Unique Experiences: A private show with a mentalist (Dr. Carl Christman) and a celebrity sound healer session. 
    Health & Beauty
    • Skincare Bundles: Full lines from Miage and INSTYTUTUM, plus Danucera clean beauty items. 
    • Medical Treatments: A $10,000 Potenza RF microneedling treatment. 
    • Sleep Aids: A Helight Sleep red light therapy device and a sleep consultation. 
    Home & Lifestyle
    • Appliances: A Thor Kitchen wine fridge. 
    • Home Services: A home renovation project management offer from Maison Construction. 
    • Gadgets: A Dooplikit 3D selfie figurine, a portable BAGCEIT purse seat, and a BlendQuik portable blender. 
    Food & Drink 
    • Luxury Spirits: Antigua Cruz Añejo Cristalino Tequila.
    • Gourmet Treats: Fetcha Chocolates and gourmet popcorn.
    Other Notable Items 
    • Retro Toy: A classic Rubik's Retro Cube.
    • Charitable Giving: Pet food for PETA's Global Compassion Fund.

      Who is predicted to win Best Actor?
      An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
      AI Overview
      For the upcoming 2026 Oscars, Michael B. Jordan for Sinners is widely predicted as the frontrunner, leading in betting odds and expert picks, with Timothée Chalamet for Marty Supreme as a strong second, though some pundits favor Chalamet for value, while Leonardo DiCaprio, Wagner Moura, and Ethan Hawke are considered long shots. Jordan's momentum from the Actor Awards solidified his lead, despite mixed results at other precursors, notes ESPN. 
      Top Contenders:
      • Michael B. Jordan (Sinners):
        The betting favorite, riding strong industry buzz and a win at the Actor Awards, reports The New York Times and Action Network. 
      • Timothée Chalamet (Marty Supreme):
        A close second in odds, seen as a potential upset pick by some for his lauded performance, say Action Network, AwardsWatch and NPR. 
      Other Nominees (Long Shots):
      • Leonardo DiCaprio (One Battle After Another): Considered a strong contender but trailing the top two, according to Variety and DraftKings Network. 
      • Wagner Moura (The Secret Agent): A Golden Globe winner for his role, notes DraftKings Network. 
      • Ethan Hawke (Blue Moon): The final nominee, with lower odds than the top contenders.
